none: PAS NLM-F7FC41: Roman Coin: Commemorative Nummus of House of Constantine from Fridaythorpe
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), commemorative Constantinopolis issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Constantinopolis helmeted wearing imperial mantle and carrying sceptre left. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory left on prow with shield and sceptre. In exergue: TRP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.…
